property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and any addresses, C.transfer either returns true without reverting and must have made all calls to the target caddress succeed (no individual call failed), or it reverts before returning; thus the function never returns false — whenever it returns it returns true and all internal low-level calls succeeded.
For any non-empty _tos, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
If transfer does not revert when called with a non-empty _tos, it must return true.
